name: Pipework
description: Wang tiles of pipe: elbows, straights, tees and crosses with rounded bends, each tile open only where its neighbor is, so the pipes join into one tangled network.

code.style: --rule: ( --gate: @r(1); --s: @pd(@r(0, 50)); --ix: @x; --iy: @y; --mx: @X; --my: @Y; --pk: $(8 * floor(0.55 + (sin(ix * 39.3467 + (iy - 1) * 11.1351 + s * 1.7) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1) + 4 * floor(0.55 + (sin(ix * 12.9898 + iy * 78.233 + s * 1) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1) + 2 * floor(0.55 + (sin(ix * 39.3467 + iy * 11.1351 + s * 1.7) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1) + floor(0.55 + (sin((ix - 1) * 12.9898 + iy * 78.233 + s * 1) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1)); --pipe: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--pipe)); -webkit-mask: @var(--po$(pk)); mask: @var(--po$(pk)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: @var(--pi$(pk)); mask: @var(--pi$(pk)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
